Live gate measurement while it runs, added to bd-01KZXWPKT4XPSB55PB5RBSAZRT.

  measured phase elapsed  14 min 44 s   against 30 min   (49% consumed)
  worker process RSS      2.43 GiB      against 4 GiB    (61% consumed, process not incremental)

At q = 2, three partitions, six edges, and a local covariance singular for 84% of supports - the most favourable configuration the harness can present. Both fixes for the degeneracy (observations 32 -> 200, or partitions 3 -> 6) multiply the dominant cost 5-6x, which would place the run well outside 30 minutes.

So the likely honest conclusion for this epic is the fallback its own acceptance already anticipates: brain-scale DIAGONAL metrics supported; dense local metrics explicitly scoped to a declared node count or support size. Recommend re-running the gate at a non-degenerate fixture to locate the real boundary, and reporting that boundary, rather than recording a pass obtained at settings where no searchlight can estimate a covariance.
